spec: SeekLiny V-slot 2020 extrusion, 800 mm, black anodised, 10 pcs
notes: 800 mm is SHORTER than the 48 in (1219 mm) long axis of the table, so these cannot span it in one piece. Fine for the cross axis (24 in = 610 mm) and for the carriage. Decide the frame layout before ordering: a spliced long rail is not a precision rail.

2 pack, so one order covers both motors. A dumb H-bridge gives PWM only: no current control, no field-oriented control, no CAN. Closed-loop position control is still possible if the Teensy reads the motor encoder. This replaces the ODESC FOC plan in the sizing study, which changes what the build teaches.

16.5 A total, not 25 A. A 775 motor pulls far more than that at stall, so this supply has to be treated as bench-limited: fuse and current-limit in firmware, and expect brownout on a simultaneous stall.

spec: Riseuvo 10 AWG inline fuse holder, 6 holders plus 6 x 40A ATC/ATO fuses
notes: A 40 A fuse protects 10 AWG wire, NOT the 16.5 A supply and not the motor. Match the fuse to the wire and the supply, not to the stall current, or the supply is the thing that fails first.

snapshot price, roughly a year old, and it looks low for this part (Pololu list is higher). One per motor gives real current telemetry for the limit. Note the range: +/-30 A saturates near stall on a 775.
The dimension driver. Check the blower and the surface before buying: every cut-to-length item waits on this. 24 x 48 in assumed until measured.

spec: SeekLiny GT2 belt, 9 mm wide, 10 m long, 2 mm pitch
notes: 9 mm wide is the right call over 6 mm. The sizing study flagged 2 mm pitch as too fine.
